resolvedUserId.title: Resolved User ID
resolvedUserId.description: The Salesforce User ID actually used: the input userId if provided, otherwise the session user ID.

forecastingTypeId.title: Forecasting Type ID
forecastingTypeId.description: Salesforce ID of the active ForecastingType for the session user.

resolvedPeriodId.title: Resolved Period ID
resolvedPeriodId.description: ID of the ForecastingPeriod that brackets today's date, or the validated input periodId when one was supplied.

availableCategories.title: Available Categories
availableCategories.description: JSON array of submittable forecast categories for this ForecastingType: [{"apiName":"CommitForecast","label":"Commit","measure":"amount"},...]. Reflects the type's displayed categories (org rollup and Most Likely settings already applied). Used by STEP 1.5 to resolve a user-stated category name to its apiName.

availableTerritories.title: Available Territories
availableTerritories.description: JSON array of territories the user can submit forecasts for: [{"territoryId":"0MI...","label":"Eastern Region (Jane Doe)"},...]. Empty for role-hierarchy types and when the user has no accessible territory.

isAmountType.title: Is Amount Type
isAmountType.description: 'true' if the ForecastingType measures dollar amounts; 'false' for quantity types. Used to format confirmation messages correctly.

resolvedForecastingCategories.title: Resolved Forecasting Categories
resolvedForecastingCategories.description: List of forecast category api names to use for this turn: the validated categoryApiNames list when one or more were supplied, otherwise the type's forecastable displayed categories — {Commit, Best Case, Pipeline} in the org's rollup flavor and Forecasting-page order; ClosedOnly, Most Likely, Omitted, and Custom are excluded. Empty when the type could not be resolved. A downstream action that filters by category binds this directly instead of asking the rep to pick one.
